notes: Hunt fixes from real hunts: the card no longer jumps between two behemoths fighting side by side (it follows the one losing health, and stays on its current one unless another is much nearer); a behemoth's BROKEN parts are kept when the card switches away and back; no more false breaks from parts that start at 0 and grow back, and refills to 87-89% now count as breaks. Hunt servers no longer pause for object searches while the native tracker feeds the card (5-10 searches per fight, up to 100 ms each). Terramane alphas are named (Sporestruck Embermane) instead of "Unidentified behemoth". Close the game fully and restart after updating.
